'''Jeff Hansen''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 5 from Billings, Mt. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub. It records only published SWCCG-related facts. It is not a biography and does not add private life.

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Slot !! Town !! Status (fan table)
|-
| Rogue 5 || Billings, Mt || Retired
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Other sourced notes ==

The original GeoCities Corellian Engineering home (Wayback 13 May 2001) billed Jeff Hansen "Rogue 5" for a "Neglected Cards" series (about 40 card reviews) and a follow-up "CounterStrategies: Protection from Misdirection."<ref name="geo2001">[https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ Original GeoCities home], 13 May 2001 (Wayback)</ref>
